```{r ed contracting predict employment}
# Merge CBP totals with fedcon summary
county_data <- fedcon %>%
  group_by(county_fips, fiscal_year) %>%
  summarise(total_obligation = sum(total_obligation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(cbp, by = c("county_fips", "fiscal_year" = "year")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_emp), !is.na(total_obligation))

# Regress total employment on contract $
model_emp <- lm(total_emp ~ total_obligation, data = county_data)
summary(model_emp)
```

```{r contract spending predict change in employment (panel)}
library(plm)

panel_data <- county_data %>%
  arrange(county_fips, fiscal_year) %>%
  group_by(county_fips) %>%
  mutate(emp_growth = total_emp - lag(total_emp)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(emp_growth))

plm_model <- plm(emp_growth ~ total_obligation, data = pdata.frame(panel_data, index = c("county_fips", "fiscal_year")), model = "within")
summary(plm_model)
```

```{r Sector interactions}
## sector interactions
model_sector <- lm(total_emp ~ total_obligation * naics_group, data = left_join(fedcon, cbp, by = c("county_fips", "fiscal_year" = "year")))
summary(model_sector)
```

```{r Effect of Federa Contract Dollars on Employment by Sector}
## Plotting
# extract and clean
coef_df <- tidy(model_sector)

# Filter for interaction terms only
interaction_effects <- coef_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "total_obligation:naics_group")) %>%
  mutate(
    naics_group = str_remove(term, "total_obligation:naics_group"),
    effect = estimate
  ) %>%
  select(naics_group, effect) %>%
  arrange(desc(effect))

ggplot(interaction_effects, aes(x = reorder(naics_group, effect), y = effect)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Federal Contract Dollars on Employment by Sector",
    subtitle = "Interaction effects from linear model (Obligation × NAICS Group)",
    x = "NAICS Industry Group",
    y = "Estimated Employment Effect per $1 Federal Dollar",
    caption = "Source: USAspending & CBP, 2017–2022"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r Compare Counties by agency Exposure}
## create indicator for agency exposure
county_agency_exposure <- fedcon %>%
  filter(fiscal_year >= 2018, is_small_business == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(county_fips, agency) %>%
  summarise(received_contract = n() > 0, .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(agency == "Department of Defense")  # Change this as needed

## merge w economic outcomes
exposure_vs_outcomes <- cbp %>%
  filter(year == 2022) %>%
  left_join(county_agency_exposure, by = "county_fips") %>%
  mutate(received_contract = ifelse(is.na(received_contract), FALSE, received_contract))

t.test(total_emp ~ received_contract, data = exposure_vs_outcomes)

ggplot(exposure_vs_outcomes, aes(x = received_contract, y = total_emp)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Employment in 2022 by DoD Contract Receipt (Small Business)",
    x = "Received DoD Contracts",
    y = "Total Private-Sector Employment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
